newsitem.title: JAPAN: Angry Japan judge ejects doomsday guru from court.
newsitem.headline: Angry Japan judge ejects doomsday guru from court.

text.p: The judge in the murder trial of doomsday cult leader Shoko Asahara lost his temper on Friday and for the fifth time ejected the defendant.
The 41-year-old Asahara, founder of the Aum Shinri Kyo (Supreme Truth Sect), was ordered to leave the Tokyo District Court 40 minutes after the start of proceedings.
The hearing was on the charge that Asahara ordered the 1989 killing of an anti-cult lawyer, his wife and their baby.
He is separately charged with ordering the March 1995 sarin nerve gas attack on the Tokyo subway system, which killed 12 and made thousands ill.
"I"ve seen so many trials but you are the only person who can"t keep quiet," chief judge Fumihiro Abe told the guru.
"I am being raped and violated," Asahara shouted as he was dragged out of the courtroom.
Asahara has refused to enter pleas on any of the 17 major charges he faces.
